thread:
Nadia: Quick planning thread for 'signals marketplace' within Optimize toolkit. Idea: recommendations are tiered (info-only, suggest, actionable-request) with explicit confidence bands and cost/savings estimates. Need to agree pilot gates and what counts as 'actionable'.

Omar: I like tiers. MVP: support two tiers - info-only (UI card) and suggest (user can request apply). Actionable-request (auto-apply) is out of scope for alpha. Confidence band must be shown (e.g., 68/95% intervals).

Felix: Metrics to gate: 1) concordance vs SME >=85% on curated prompts, 2) expected token savings estimate error <=20% on sampled traffic, 3) false-positive alert rate <=12% over 14d. If any breach, we revert suggestions for that route.

Tara: Pilot customers: BlueCrest (hosted) and GammaApps (dedicated). BlueCrest willing to try suggest tier; GammaApps requires a ticketed apply and per-tenant opt-in. Add a CSV export for audit for GammaApps but gated behind telemetry opt-in.

Yvonne: UX notes: Console card should show: recommendation type, confidence band, estimated monthly $ savings, expected p50 latency delta, and a 3-line rationale (why we suggested it). Also link to "explainability snippet" for ops: short bullet list of signals (e.g., repeated prefixes, low kv-hit rate).

Nadia: Runtime constraints: batching heuristics must not increase p95 beyond a configurable threshold. Suggest default p95 bound = +10% relative. For prefix cache, include an estimation of prefix reuse rate and potential cold-start penalty.

Omar: Eval alerts: they should be rule-based initially. Example rule: if quality.delta > 2.0% over 7d AND sample_count >= 100 then fire. Include triage bundle but only if tenant.telemetry_consent == true.

Felix: Proposing a lightweight canary workflow for pilot: apply suggestion to 2% traffic for 12h, evaluate p50/p95/LR and eval signal; if stable, expand to 10% for 24h, then manual approve for broader apply. Dedicated customers always require a ticket to progress beyond 0%.

Tara: Owners and quick tasks: Nadia -> runtime hooks and canary implementation; Omar -> alert rules + eval thresholds; Felix -> concordance harness and token-savings estimator; Yvonne -> Console card & explainability snippets; Nadia/Tara -> pilot onboarding docs and privacy checklist. Target alpha handoff in 4w.

Yvonne: One more: add a small "why not apply" ETA when recommendation confidence is low, listing the missing signals (e.g., insufficient telemetry, low sample size). This should reduce CS load when customers ask why no auto-apply.

infra-bot: deploy planned: optimize-signals/alpha -> staging at 3512345696 by @ci-bot

Nadia: Risk note: our simulated prompt sets might not capture long-tail user prompts. Mitigation: require tenant-level shadowing for one week to calibrate before recommending quant profiles. Mark "shadowing required" as blocking for quant recommendations in dedicated installs.

Omar: I'll sketch the alert YAML for ops review:

```yaml
alert:
  id: "optimize.signals.quality_drift"
  metric: "quality.delta"
  window: "7d"
  threshold_pct: 2.0
  min_samples: 100
  notify: ["sre", "product", "cs"]
  attach_triage_bundle_if: "telemetry_consent"
```

Felix: I'll publish the concordance dashboard and a small notebook showing sample tradeoffs. Posting links in this thread when up.

Tara: CS ask: add per-tenant toggle in Console (opt-in for recommendations + separate opt-in for exporting triage bundles). GammaApps legal will need the latter. Make export opt-in a hard gate.

Nadia: Agreed. We'll keep export disabled by default. We'll consolidate this into a short spec doc and share with pilot customers. Ping if any blockers. :white_check_mark:
